nom: fresh Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and a gentle, non-drying cleanse, though one reviewer with sensitive skin says the product tore up her skin and smelled too chemical.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the wash does not dry them out further and leaves skin feeling soft, moisturized, and never overdrying.
segments.oily: One reviewer describing oily, acne- and period-prone skin uses it as a lighter, gel-like alternative to a creamier exfoliating cleanser and finds it just exfoliating enough.
segments.mature: A reviewer with 60-year-old skin reports smoother, silkier skin with visibly less noticeable pores after three months of use.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, say the wash is not drying and leaves skin soft or lightly moisturized; one reviewer with sensitive skin says it tore up her skin instead.
concerns.aging: One reviewer with mature (60-year-old) skin reports smoother, firmer-looking skin and less visible pores after three months of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with oily, acne- and period-prone skin uses it as a regular staple without mentioning breakouts, describing it as moisturizing and just gently exfoliating.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with sensitive, red skin reports it cleaned her face without drying it out and left a glow; no other reviewer specifically discusses redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive, dry skin says it improved her skin tone and texture without damaging her skin barrier.

extraits.texte: The smell is so chemically, and its so rough on my skin. I have more sensitive skin and this tore my skin up.

I didn't find this to have enough scrub. You could feel some grain in the product when you squeezed it out, but once I started to apply to my face, what little sugar scrub just dissolved. This product would be better for someone who wants a very light scrub (and isn't allergic to strawberries) Unfortunately for me, I want to feel the grains and get a high grit to scrub my face. If you're like me, then this product is not for you. Therefore this product does what it advertised: a gentle scrub.

I bought this a couple of months ago and loved it. My skin is very sensitive and red, so I was pleasantly surprised when it cleaned my face without drying it out and left a nice glow to it. I wanted to repurchase but the price doubled!?! I'm broke now so I'll just go cry..

To get the full benefit of this delicate scrub be careful not to use with too much water. It smells lovely and works quite well. Having used for 3 months, my 60 year old skin is smooth and silky with less visable pores.

I love this stuff! I read some of the other reviews, and I definietly disagree. I have sensitive dry skin, but this stuff works beautifully! It is all natural and has improved my skin tone and texture over time. I use this once a day, and its made a huge differnce. It does have a scent, but its natural, and not artificial. I dont mind the smell. It's personal preference I guess. If youre looking for a natural exfolient that wont destroy your skins barrier, this is it!

I have been using fresh products as a teen and am happy they are easier to find now on here. I have oily, period prone acne, seasonal skin. This is my go to for when I need to go from a creamer exfoliating cleanser to a more gel like. I love how it is not to exfoliating, just enough, a wash, and leaves my skin moisturized. It's my staple from spring-fall.
I loved it! My skin is so dry just by itself so using this product was so nice just because it's so gentle and not to rough on my skin!
